lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: python-flask-lemur-export-private-key-without-requires-key-gate
title: Certificate export passes cert.private_key to plugin regardless of requires_key authorization gate
summary: 'The export endpoint only performed the ownership and permission check inside the `if plugin.requires_key:`
  branch, yet it always passed `cert.private_key` to `plugin.export(...)`. A plugin that does not declare
  `requires_key` could therefore be chosen to obtain private key material without any authorization check.
  This lets a user without rights to the certificate extract its private key. The key-view audit log entry
  was also written outside that gate.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-863
- CWE-285
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- python
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 5683bbea8b10cce07f9a8abf1e4a7d3b2031c585
  vulnerable_ref: 5683bbea8b10cce07f9a8abf1e4a7d3b2031c585^
  patched_ref: 5683bbea8b10cce07f9a8abf1e4a7d3b2031c585
  repository: https://github.com/Netflix/lemur
rule:
  message: '`cert.private_key` is passed directly to a plugin export call. Key material must only be loaded
    after the key-view authorization check, inside the `requires_key` branch. Otherwise a plugin that
    does not require a key can bypass the check.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: $PLUGIN.export($BODY, $CHAIN, $CERT.private_key, ...)
  - pattern-not-inside: "if $PLUGIN.requires_key:\n    ...\n"
fix:
  guidance: 'Initialise `private_key = None` and only assign `cert.private_key` inside the `if plugin.requires_key:`
    branch, after the creator or CertificatePermission check succeeds. Write the key_view audit log entry
    in that same branch. Pass the local `private_key` variable to `plugin.export`.

    '
  example: "private_key = None\nif plugin.requires_key:\n    if not cert.private_key:\n        return\
    \ dict(message=\"no key found\"), 400\n    if g.current_user != cert.user:\n        permission = CertificatePermission(owner_role,\
    \ [x.name for x in cert.roles])\n        if not permission.can():\n            return dict(message=\"\
    You are not authorized to export this certificate.\"), 403\n    log_service.create(g.current_user,\
    \ \"key_view\", certificate=cert)\n    private_key = cert.private_key\n\nextension, passphrase, data\
    \ = plugin.export(cert.body, cert.chain, private_key, options)\n"
